subject: Request: trial extension & top-up — integration sprint stalled
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara@bluequarry.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Henderson <tom.h@bluequarry.ai>
Date: 2027-05-29T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: trial extension & top-up — integration sprint stalled

Hi Karthik,

Quick note from our engineering lead — we've hit an unexpected data-mapping blocker in the adapter for our payments feed. The team needs approximately two full sprints to stabilize parsing and end-to-end tests. That pushes our demo window and evaluation activity out by ~10 business days.

We really want to keep momentum with Redwood (your runtime + embeddings look very promising) but the current trial allocation will run out before we can complete the blocked work. Can you advise on a short extension (2 weeks) and a small top-up of credits so we can finish the integration and run the demo you scheduled?

I've attached a short log extract and a pcap that shows the failing handshake; Tom added an updated MVP scope so you can see the pieces that are blocked. We can jump on a 30-minute call if helpful.

Attachments: integration-log.txt, network-trace.pcap, bluequarry-mvp-scope-v2.pdf

Thanks — Sara
Sara Lim
Head of Integrations, BlueQuarry
sara@bluequarry.ai
+1 415 555 0199
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara@bluequarry.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension & top-up — integration sprint stalled

Sara —

Thanks for the note and for sending the logs; I pulled a quick pass through the trace and that looks like a connector timeout rather than a model-side issue. Appreciate the context and the MVP doc.

I can provision a temporary 2-week trial extension and put up to 50k tokens as a temporary top-up pending Sales Ops sign-off. I'll loop Marissa from Sales Ops to confirm the exact credit amount and any contract/expiration conditions. Can you confirm the demo date you'd like to reschedule to (range works fine)? Also, if you can share a brief ETA on the engineering ticket (Jira ID or similar) that helps us note the condition in the approval.

If it's helpful I can also add a short, one-off grace period to your account to avoid throttling during the re-run.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Karthik / Hannah —

Forwarding BlueQuarry's request. They've attached logs and an updated MVP scope; Sara says the team needs two sprints (~10 business days) to finish the adapter. Customer looks engaged and the demo is a high-propensity opportunity (see HubSpot deal BQ-2025-987).

As a proposed makegood, thinking: 2-week extension + 75k token credit (one-time), subject to:
- BlueQuarry confirms new demo date within the extension window
- Eng ticket ETA (we want a clear remediation plan)
- Customer signoff on a short onboarding checklist (we complete a joint 30-min runbook call)

If we approve the credit, we'd log this as a one-time concession against the deal (no change to list price). Please advise if 75k is too generous; I picked that number based on their current trial consumption rate (see last 7 days).

Attachments: internal-note-BQ-987.txt (internal), bluequarry-mvp-scope-v2.pdf

Thanks — Marissa

Team —

Approve the concession as requested with the following conditions:
1) 2-week extension from 2027-05-31 to 2027-06-14 (we'll mark account with expiration override)
2) One-time 75k token credit (non-recurring) — Sales Ops to apply and document in HubSpot under BQ-2025-987

Marissa — once you apply the credit and update HubSpot, let Karthik/Sara know and we'll reschedule the demo.
